name: Laplacian, Student-t, distro zoo (sonar)
plain: Heavy-tailed alternatives to Gaussian. The Laplacian adds a quarter of Gaussian so it is a mixture. The Student-t is scaled, clipped by quantile and compressed by a square-root. A distro node exposes 26 torch distributions.
math:
Laplacian: n = ε/4 + Laplace(0,1). normalized.
Student-t: t~T(df=1,scale=.2); q=quantile(|t|,.75)·nq; t←clamp(t,−q,q); out=sign(t)·|t|^.5. normalized=False.
Distro: exponential, cauchy, geometric, log_normal, normal, beta, continuous_bernoulli, dirichlet, fisher_snedecor, gamma, gumbel, inverse_gamma, kumaraswamy, laplacian, lkjcholesky, lrmvariate_normal, mvariate_normal, pareto, poisson, relaxed_bernoulli, relaxed_onehotcategorical, studentt, uniform, vonmises, weibull, wishart; optional quantile normalize.

props.distribution: Laplace + Gaussian mix; Student-t clipped; any torch distribution
props.normalizes_variance: Laplacian yes, Student-t no in sonar; BFS analytically
